topics.description: Child care fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with the US government launching an investigation into the matter. The state has been required to provide documents by next week, and lawmakers are grilling officials over the issue.
topics.reason: US government investigation and lawmaker scrutiny

topics.description: The FBI is facing cybersecurity concerns, with a suspicious breach of its surveillance network. US suspects China as the perpetrator, and the agency is investigating the matter.
topics.reason: Suspicious breach of FBI surveillance network
